 This Appeal, Coming On For Dismissal, This Day,
Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr Justice T.G. Shivashankare Gowda
 Oral Judgment
There is no representation on behalf of the appellant.
As per order dated 24.04.2024, the matter was ordered to be listed for dismissal on 25.04.2024.
On 25.04.2024, Smt.Leelavathi, learned advocate appearing on behalf of Smt.Indumathi S.R. sought adjournment on the ground of Smt.Indumathi S.R. is unwell.
Hence the matter was directed to be listed after summer vacation-2024.
When the matter was listed on 25.07.2024, it was adjourned because of illness of the learned counsel for the insurance company.
Today also there is no representation on behalf of the appellant in spite of matter being posted for dismissal.
This would indicate that neither the NC: 2024:KHC:32287 appellant nor her counsel are interested in prosecuting the appeal.
Hence, the appeal stands dismissed for non- prosecution.

SD/-
